title: Warm Spicy Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A halal-friendly Spanish dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and spices, with a sour and slightly sweet flavor profile, and a bouncy qq texture from the saffron and rice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the smoked paprika, saffron threads, and red food coloring to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the uncooked white rice to the pan and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the lemon juice to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pan and stir to combine with the rice and spice mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
